exposure: Abnormal GpG methylation in amniotic fluid cells (H19 gene)
cohort: A total of 237 sets of amniotic fluid cells were collected from patients receiving prenatal diagnosis in Guangzhou, China, between April 2010 and October 2011, comprising 156 singleton and 81 twin pregnancies.
finding: No effect of GapG methylation in the second trimester of pregnancy on the adverse health risk of offspring was found, including deformities.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery showed no significant effect on GapG methylation level of H19 in the second trimester of pregnancy.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was analyzed as a variable but not explicitly for inclusion/exclusion criteria.
gest_age: Gestational age was analyzed but not explicitly for inclusion/exclusion criteria.
